title: Kulbergs' government declaration promises three stages of reforms
summary_full: On Tuesday, 17 November, representatives of the United List and the National Alliance signed a political cooperation agreement and a declaration setting out the plans for Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs’ (United List) second government.
